title: Seating Chart Revision Freeze Breach
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:seating week_bucket=* freeze_breach=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(freeze_breach="yes",1,0))) as matched by week_bucket
| eval a_revision_freeze_breach_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_revision_freeze_breach_pct
description: Measures the percentage of late seating edits that end with a revision freeze breach by week bucket.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which week bucket are helping or hurting late seating edits.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a revision freeze breach` on `event:seating` events and summarize the hit rate by `week_bucket`.
visualization: Table of week bucket with percentage of late seating edits ending with a revision freeze breach.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often a revision freeze breach happens for each week bucket so you can see where late seating edits go smoothly or get stuck.
